subject: titty-storage
q: FOXWIFE TITTY STORAGE holds a full leather outfit. Nobody has said how much it holds, what else is in it, or whether anyone else on this compound has one.
detail:
CONFIRMED: it exists, it holds whole objects, a bikini and thigh highs and a cloak came out of it intact and ready to wear, and Viraena reaches into it from behind without asking, which means SHE HAS ALWAYS KNOWN IT WAS THERE.

UNKNOWN AND NOT BEING ASSUMED:
CAPACITY. One outfit, or a thousand years of outfits.
WHAT ELSE IS IN THERE. A thousand-year-old cloak was retrieved on request within about two seconds, which suggests ORDER rather than a pile.
WHETHER IT IS MAGIC OR ANATOMY. Selene got the MAGIC of the kitsune inheritance while her sister got the mindset, so a magical reading is available — BUT THE NAME SAYS FOXWIFE AND IT SAYS TITTY, AND THE ARCHIVE IS NOT DECIDING WHICH HALF OF THAT IS THE MECHANISM.
WHETHER ANYONE ELSE HAS ONE. Thirty-two women at Ghost Haven and a great many of them are extremely well equipped for the theory.
WHETHER THINGS AGE IN THERE. A thousand-year-old leather bikini came out wearable, which is either very good tanning or the storage does something.

AND ONE PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE WORTH FLAGGING RATHER THAN SOLVING: SILKEN EMBRACE HAS A CONTAINMENT DOCTRINE AND A FRONT LAW, and neither of them has ever been told that one of the women in this compound is carrying a cargo hold. THE BOUTIQUE RECEIVES CUP, SHAPE, HANDFEEL AND FULL CHEST INTEGRATION. NOTHING ON THAT HANDOFF LIST COVERS VOLUME THAT IS NOT HERS.
